searchText: <ChrisLinn> hi all. is there any formal doc/spec/paper describing eth2.0 sharding <mratsim> eth2.0-specs <ChrisLinn> sorry but to me https://github.com/ethereum/wiki/wiki/Sharding-FAQ is not formal enough and https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/blob/dev/specs/core/1_shard-data-chains.md doesn't describe the whole design <mratsim> the spec is currently focused on implementation. The design parts are disseminated in ethresear.ch and also the eth2.0-specs issues/PR <mratsim> ideally a companion repo/document should be written that explains why the implementation is done this way but it does not exist. <mratsim> For formal spec, the team that wrote KEVM is doing an impelmentation of the beacon chain in K at the moment <ChrisLinn> so there's no formal/published one i can refer to <ChrisLinn> thx The phase 0 and phase 1 specs listed here come together as the spec but do not contain the rationale behind the design Vitalik maintains this design rationale doc in conjunction -- https://notes.ethereum.org/@vbuterin/rkhCgQteN?type=view I made this doc to help bring people up to speed on the phase 0 spec but it is not polished and incomplete on some sections -- https://notes.ethereum.org/@djrtwo/Bkn3zpwxB?type=view this Casper FFG paper from vitalik can be helpful as well: https://vitalik.ca/files/casper_note.html **vbuterin** Here's the "paper" version of that: **vbuterin** https://arxiv.org/abs/1710.09437 <ChrisLinn> thx. if i get it correctly, this paper is to explain the design rationale of eth2.0. <ChrisLinn> i am actually looking for the design/implementation for sharding specifically. and as i am using it for academic purpose, it has to be more formal than notes/threads.

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content:
The phase 0 and phase 1 specs listed here come together as the spec but do not contain the rationale behind the design
Vitalik maintains this design rationale doc in conjunction -- https://notes.ethereum.org/@vbuterin/rkhCgQteN?type=view
I made this doc to help bring people up to speed on the phase 0 spec but it is not polished and incomplete on some sections -- https://notes.ethereum.org/@djrtwo/Bkn3zpwxB?type=view
